processed_chunks.text: Introduction to Aksha Aksha - Intelligent surveillance system is envisioned to automatically monitor the environment or premises with less or without human intervention. Such monitoring tasks include automatically detecting objects, unusual situations and performing further analysis and actions. Computer vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Gen AI play a very important role in developing such intelligent systems.
Aksha architectural approaches We provide below mentioned architectural approaches Aksha on Edge (On Premise) Aksha UI & Backend on Edge Aksha on Edge & Cloud Aksha UI on Cloud & Backend on Edge ‹#›

Aksha Aksha, the smart surveillance system for the businesses that value employee safety. It is self learning system which detects object & anomalies using the power of Artificial Intelligence. It enables user to set customized alerts at fingertips. ‹#› Main features Live recording and processing of data Object detection Image analysis using Gen AI Objects: Person, supine person, no helmet, helmet, car, bicycle, truck, motorbike, backpack, handbag, gate open, gate closed, fork lift, crowd Insight report generation & analysis Using Gen AI Unsupervised learning based Anomaly detection Customized alert creation at fingertips

Real-time Data Processing: Facilitates real-time data streaming for timely insights and actions. High Availability: Maintains reliable performance through Kubernetes orchestration and Kafka’s distributed messaging.
